thread:
carla_sales: Heads-up — NimbusX POC hitting intermittent 503s and a few 401s during traffic ramp. Customer is on a demo call in ~25m. Can we triage now? they ramped to ~200rps and spikes started around 11:03 UTC.

alex_g_oncall: i'm on it. can you share request ids / example logs? also which model + route?

carla_sales: route: /v1/generate (hosted). model: redwood-epx-small. sample req id: req_8a7f2c. log snippet:
```
ERROR 503 GatewayError request_id=req_8a7f2c worker=gpuhost-07 "failed to fetch kvcache"
```

kevin_se: picking this up with eng-runtime. is this after warmup or during steady state?

carla_sales: started after the ramp during demo warmup. 401s affect a small subset — might be token refresh related.

jordan_r_eng: 401s usually token expiry/refresh races. 503 + kvcache message could indicate cache shard pressure or OOM on the cache host.

alex_g_oncall: checking infra metrics now — GPU mem is fine but cache-shard-2 has high disk IO and eviction spikes at 11:02:54.

deploy-bot: deployment job #4257 for redwood-epx-small completed successfully at 10:59:12 UTC

maria_s_security: FYI customer mentioned short-lived tokens with client-side refresh. suggest checking clock skew and refresh timing.

kevin_se: proposed plan: (1) sales throttles ramp by 50% to stabilize demo, (2) eng-runtime tune kvcache memory allocation, (3) schedule a 15m change window if a restart is required. agree?

jordan_r_eng: agree. i'll create an eng-runtime ticket and add runbook steps — if cache-shard-2 latency >200ms swap to shard-1. avoid restarts unless necessary.

carla_sales: i'll tell the customer to slow ramp now. also they asked about burst pricing — need to follow up after.

kevin_se: note for comms: "burst promo: first 2 hours at 50% off" (internal until legal signs off) :grimacing:

alex_g_oncall: adjusted traffic rule for account nimbusx to max_rps=100 at 11:07 UTC. monitoring.

alex_g_oncall: update: after throttling, 503s dropped to near zero. 401s persist at ~0.2% — looks like a refresh race on their side.

maria_s_security: ask them to verify token refresh flow and NTP sync. recommend refreshing tokens at expiry -30s to avoid overlap.

carla_sales: on the call now, they accepted slowing the ramp and want a short postmortem.

jordan_r_eng: ticket ENG-7321 created, assigned to eng-runtime + infra-sre. link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-7321

kevin_se: i'll own customer comms + pricing follow-up. eng: ETA for the kvcache config change?

jordan_r_eng: change pushed to staging, can promote to prod in a 15m window. proposed slot 11:25 UTC.

carla_sales: 11:25 works for customer. please post status updates here. thanks everyone :heart:

alex_g_oncall: monitoring steady. i'll post a metrics snapshot in 30m.

deploy-bot: incident note: throttling rule applied to account nimbusx by alex_g_oncall at 11:07 UTC
